newsitem.title: UK: Amey wins 21 mln stg HMS Nelson service deal.
newsitem.headline: Amey wins 21 mln stg HMS Nelson service deal.

text.p: Amey Plc said on Tuesday it had won the first Royal Navy facilities management deal of its kind by clinching a 21 million stg five-year contract for support services for HMS Nelson in Portsmouth, southern England.

Amey will manage and deliver accommodation services, give catering support, take on cleaning, works services, mail and messenger services, transport and driver training and other administration support services, it said in a statement.

"Subject to satisfactory performance, the contract can be progressively extended to cover other activities such as: clothing and general stores management; recreational services; personnel support duties, bill paying...with a total potential value of approximately 43 million stg," Amey stated.
